name: Exp_ColorJFatl_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_StDev custom indicator, which combines a JFATL (JMA-smoothed FATL) moving average with Standard Deviation channels. It opens and closes positions using three signal modes: point-based (dot signals), directional (line direction change), or disabled, allowing flexible entry and exit logic on trend reversals or continuations.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JFATL（JMA平滑FATL）移动平均线和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、方向信号、禁用）来开仓和平仓，在趋势反转或延续时灵活执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于JFATL（JMA平滑的FATL数字滤波器）指标配合标准差通道进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件有两种模式：POINT模式通过检测指标缓冲区中的买入/卖出点信号（非EMPTY_VALUE）来触发开仓；DIRECT模式通过检测JFATL线的方向变化（如底部转折或顶部转折）来触发。出场条件同样支持两种模式：POINT模式使用相反方向的点信号平仓；DIRECT模式在JFATL线方向反转时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损后保证金/余额比例或固定手数五种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，支持止损和止盈设置，并有偏差滑点控制。策略通过SignalBar参数允许在非零号K线上取信号以实现回测验证，同时使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is trend-following based on the JFATL indicator (a JMA-smoothed FATL digital filter) combined with Standard Deviation channels. Entry conditions operate in two modes: POINT mode triggers trades when dot signals appear in the indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values); DIRECT mode triggers on JFATL line direction changes such as bottom reversals (Line[0]>Line[1] && Line[1]<Line[2]) or top reversals. Exit conditions mirror entry logic with two modes: POINT mode uses opposite-direction dot signals for closing; DIRECT mode closes when the JFATL line direction reverses. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enum, supporting five modes including percentage of free margin, balance, post-loss margin/balance, or fixed lot size. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with configurable stop loss, take profit, and slippage deviation control. The strategy allows signal verification on non-zero bars via SignalBar and uses an IsNewBar mechanism to prevent redundant calculations within the same bar.

pros: 灵活的信号模式设计，开仓和平仓可以独立选择点信号或方向信号，适应不同交易风格
使用JFATL数字滤波器配合标准差通道，兼顾趋势跟踪和波动率自适应
内置IsNewBar新K线检测和历史数据加载机制，避免重复计算和信号闪烁
五种仓位管理模式提供灵活的资金管理选择
Recount机制确保指标数据读取失败时安全重试而非执行错误交易
pros_en: Flexible signal mode design allowing independent selection of dot or directional signals for entry and exit, adapting to different trading styles
JFATL digital filter combined with Standard Deviation channels provides both trend-following and volatility-adaptive capabilities
Built-in IsNewBar detection and history loading mechanism prevents redundant calculations and signal repainting
Five position sizing modes offer flexible money management options
Recount mechanism ensures safe retry on indicator data read failures rather than executing erroneous trades
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ColorJFatl_StDev，若指标未正确安装则EA无法运行
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期可能偏大，实际风险回报比需根据品种调整
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高点差时段或非活跃时段可能产生不利成交
平仓使用方向模式（DIRECT）时仅比较两根K线的线值变化，可能产生频繁的虚假平仓信号
没有显式的持仓检查逻辑，完全依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数处理持仓管理
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ColorJFatl_StDev; EA fails to run if the indicator is not properly installed
Default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points may be too wide for H4 timeframe; risk-reward ratio needs adjustment per instrument
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during high-spread or inactive periods
DIRECT mode exit compares only two bars of line values, which may generate frequent false exit signals in choppy markets
No explicit position check logic; relies entirely on TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for position management
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在不利条件下开仓
添加追踪止损功能以锁定浮动利润，减少利润回吐风险
增加持仓数量检查和同向重复开仓防护逻辑
为DIRECT模式平仓增加确认条件（如连续两根K线确认方向变化），减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits and reduce profit giveback risk
Add position count checks and duplicate same-direction entry protection logic
Add confirmation conditions for DIRECT mode exits (e.g., two consecutive bars confirming direction change) to reduce false signals

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失或版本不匹配可能导致EA初始化失败
无点差过滤，在高点差市场条件下可能产生不利滑点成交
DIRECT模式平仓条件较弱，可能在震荡行情中频繁进出导致连续亏损
无显式持仓数量限制，在极端情况下可能过度开仓
risk_points_en: Depends on external custom indicator; missing or version-mismatched indicator can cause EA initialization failure
No spread filter; may result in unfavorable slippage fills during high-spread market conditions
Weak DIRECT mode exit conditions may cause frequent entries and exits in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
No explicit position count limit; may over-commit in extreme conditions
